corrections.reason: Initial weightShift is 2; the label table at line 1686 maps 2 to 12-20 sec. Derive label from state on initialization.
Match the actual emitted instruction 'audible breaths between sentences'. Prompt unchanged.
Use a check mark for the selected checkbox glyph.

composition: Fixed order: [CAMERA], [SUBJECT], [CONSTRAINTS]. Separate present sections by two newlines; join camera/subject sentences with one space; constraints with '. ' plus final period.
Camera and human sections are independently enabled. Active antiGlitch constraints remain even if both sections are disabled.
Slider values of zero omit the associated fragment. driftFreq matters only if handDrift > 0; orbitSpeed/direction only if orbit is enabled.
Stop-motion camera effect appears before Operator behavior even though orbit is computed first.
Device and activity are unconditional within enabled sections; empty selection does not represent a valid enum value.
Builtin presets merge camera/human only: retain current sections and antiGlitch. Custom presets also merge supplied sections/antiGlitch, so old partial presets depend on the prior state.
Output is a motion/camera modifier. No subject identity, environment, dialogue text, model ID, FPS setting or resolution parameter is collected.
Numbers, including 12 fps for puppet_stopmotion, are natural-language prompt requests; do not silently turn them into provider settings.
No prompt-generation API call in this module. Storage key imperfectionEnginePresets; legacy export is a name-to-state map in imperfection_engine_presets.json.
decisions: Port as a small code adapter with declarative options/presets; current compileRecipe supports substitutions only, not conditional clauses/joins. Do not introduce executable user recipes.
Keep negative instructions inside [CONSTRAINTS] for output parity; do not transfer them silently to a separate negativePrompt.
Preserve generated prompt wording in this review. UI corrections above do not change prompt intent.
Store custom tool presets per named V6 setup with stable preset IDs and separate display names. Keep legacy name-to-state import.
Defaults restore should restore controls/catalog settings without deleting user presets. Setup snapshot/restore must include tool configuration.
Offer explicit append/replace placement of this modifier at the aggregator bridge; neither action starts paid generation.
